positive_x.description: Team attacking towards x = 105 in this period.
positive_x.title: Positive X

evidence.description: event_ids / match refs that support it.
evidence.title: Evidence

illustrative.description: True for hand-written fixture data (not simulated).
illustrative.title: Illustrative

set_piece_ref.description: Links shots/goals to the corner that created them.
set_piece_ref.title: Set Piece Ref

t.description: Match clock in seconds since kick-off (second half starts at 2700).
t.title: T

headline.description: Text with {claim_id.field} placeholders, verified by code.
headline.title: Headline

expected.description: Mean of pre-match sims at this minute.
expected.title: Expected

LeverChanges.description: Partial levers: only the fields an option or a Plan B rule changes.
LeverChanges.title: LeverChanges

press_target.description: Opponent player_id, or null for none.
press_target.title: Press Target

precomputed.description: The demo bundle is precomputed; the UI must say so.
precomputed.title: Precomputed

believer.description: Owner of a believed matrix; null for true.
believer.title: Believer

col_probs.description: Believed matrices: the believer's probabilities over the opponent options.
col_probs.title: Col Probs

MatrixReading.description: How one team reads the matrix (computed in code, see engine.duel).

best_guess.description: Only when column probabilities are known.
best_guess.title: Best Guess

best_response.description: Opponent option_id -> this team's best option_id.
best_response.title: Best Response

MatrixReading.title: MatrixReading

OpponentPlanEstimate.description: Pre-match: the analyst's guess of the opponent's levers (never the opponent's real plan).
OpponentPlanEstimate.title: OpponentPlanEstimate

estimated.description: True when this is an analyst's guess of the OPPONENT.
estimated.title: Estimated

lever_evidence.description: Lever name -> claim_ids. Every non-default lever needs one.
lever_evidence.title: Lever Evidence

regret_xpts.description: xPts(best response) - xPts(chosen) on the true matrix; >= 0.
regret_xpts.title: Regret Xpts

RenderFrame.description: Visual layer only (ball-anchored shapes). No metric is computed from these positions.
RenderFrame.title: RenderFrame

ScoutingSummary.description: What a bench's analyst reported before kick-off (findings point to claims in `claims`).
ScoutingSummary.title: ScoutingSummary

Seal.description: Commit of the canonical plan JSON (everything except `sealed`). See contracts.sealing.
Seal.title: Seal

SealedChoice.description: Commit only: the option and salt stay hidden until the reveal (see contracts.sealing).
SealedChoice.title: SealedChoice

eval.description: Aggregated E1..E8 results for the panel.
eval.title: Eval

illustrative.description: True for fixture bundles (hand-made, not simulated).
illustrative.title: Illustrative
